_notes.source: fundedtradingplus.com blocks automated access (Cloudflare 403), so its pages were read from Internet Archive copies of the official site: https://www.fundedtradingplus.com/prop-trading-challenges/one-step (3 Jul 2026), https://www.fundedtradingplus.com/prop-trading-challenges/two-step (3 Jul 2026), https://www.fundedtradingplus.com/prop-trading-challenges/instant-funding (27 Sep 2026), https://www.fundedtradingplus.com/about-us (3 Jul 2026), https://www.fundedtradingplus.com/terms-conditions/ (27 Sep 2026). Live help centre read directly on 2026-10-03: https://help.fundedtradingplus.com/1-step-express-program-information/ , /2-step-classic-program-information/ , /instant-program-information/ , /activation-accounts-getting-started/ , /activation-accounts-pricing-and-fees/ , /activation-accounts-challenge-rules/ , /activation-accounts-funded-account-rules/ , /activation-accounts-payouts-and-withdrawals/ , /profit-split/ , /prohibited-countries/
_notes.pricing: standard = the per-size list price in each program page's product data (shown crossed out on the page next to a code price). Each archived page displayed a 30% code price for the $100K size only: WC30 on the 1-Step and 2-Step pages (July 2026, $549 -> $384.30) and FUNDED30 on the Instant page (27 Sep 2026, $4,499 -> $3,149.30). Code prices for other sizes were not shown and the codes may have expired, so promo is null everywhere and no promo_code is set. A 30% code appeared on every snapshot checked, so the list price may work as an anchor - confirm the live price with a screenshot before publishing. Prices include VAT. Resets are offered at a 20% discount on 1-Step and 2-Step.
_notes.billing: All prices are one-time fees (the About page says no recurring monthly fees). Activation Accounts are paid in two parts: a $4 challenge fee up front (the 'standard' price here) and an activation fee only after passing, stored as funded_fee: $179 ($25K), $299 ($50K), $489 ($100K), $969 ($200K). No fee refund is stated for any program.
_notes.add_ons: Paid checkout add-ons: 1-Step and Instant - scaling plan to $5M (+15%), 90% starting split (+15%), payouts every 3 days (+15%). 2-Step - 9% max drawdown (+20%), 85% starting split (+15%). Not available on Activation Accounts.
_notes.profit_split: All programs start at 80%. The help centre says the split rises to 90% once the funded account reaches 20% profit, or from the start with a paid add-on. The 1-Step, 2-Step and Instant product pages say 'Up to 100% Reward Split', so profit_split_max is 100 for those; the help centre doesn't explain how 100% is reached. Activation Accounts stay at 80% (no increase).
_notes.drawdown: 1-Step Express and Instant: 6% max loss trails the closed-balance high-water mark and stops trailing at the starting balance. 2-Step Classic: 8% static. Activation Accounts: 6% static on the challenge, then 6% trailing equity (locks at starting balance) once funded. Daily loss on 1-Step and 2-Step is measured from the prior day's closed balance. Instant daily loss: the help centre says the higher of prior-day balance or equity at 17:00 EST; the product page FAQ says prior-day closed balance.
_notes.activation_accounts: New program (help centre articles dated 18 Sep 2026). Challenge: 2% target, 4% daily, 6% static max loss, no consistency, no minimum days. Funded: 3% daily, 6% trailing max loss, 25% consistency at payout, payout eligibility needs 3% profit and 10 trading days. Limits: max 5 activated accounts / $250K combined / 10 activations per month. 1:30 leverage, no add-ons, no scaling. The help centre text says 'Four' sizes but lists $25K/$50K/$100K in one place and $25K-$200K in the price table; the price table was used. No archived product page for this program was found.
_notes.other_rules: 2-Step Classic has a 3% per-symbol loss limit (hard breach). Instant does not allow weekend holding (positions closed 4:30pm EST Friday). All accounts must place at least one trade every 30 days. Leverage: 1:30 on 1-Step, Instant and Activation, 1:50 on 2-Step. Legacy programs (Experienced, Advanced, Premium) are retired and not listed.
_notes.rule_units: Forex rules are % of account size.
_notes.null_means: Not stated on the official pages checked (product pages via Internet Archive, live help centre). Check fundedtradingplus.com program pages or help.fundedtradingplus.com before publishing.

firm.name: Funded Trading Plus
firm.name_note: Often shortened to FTP or FT+. Operated by Acello Ltd (England and Wales). Bought by the prop firm Instant Funding in May 2026; both brands still run separately.
firm.about: Funded Trading Plus is a UK prop firm launched in 2021, run by Acello Ltd from London. It sells simulated accounts for forex and other CFDs through one-step, two-step and no-evaluation programs on MT5 and Match-Trader. It also sells 'Activation' accounts with a small upfront fee and a much larger fee due after passing; these aren't listed here.

countries.notes: Combined from the help centre's Prohibited Countries page (updated 26 Aug 2026) and the longer list in the site footer and terms. The footer adds Central African Republic, Chad, Congo, DR Congo, Haiti, Nicaragua and Venezuela, which the help centre page leaves out. The Crimea, Donetsk, Luhansk, Kherson and Zaporizhzhia regions of Ukraine are also blocked (the rest of Ukraine is not). US residents can't use MT5 through the firm; product pages also offer Match-Trader. The firm says the list can change at its discretion.
